question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**fascination**" means the feeling of being greatly interested or attracted by something.
 
• Mechanical Engineering maintaining its charm and **fascination** emphasizes its continuous appeal and interest despite advancements in the digital world.
 
• The other options: "**attention**," "**clemency**," and "**tension**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Even in today's digital world, this stream has its charm and fascination__, the theories of Mechanical Engineering are used in scheming some of the best and most state-of-the-art motor vehicles, developed units, airplanes as well as other industrial machinery.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Attention (ध्यान)**: refers to focusing on something or someone.
 
• **Clemency (दयालुता)**: means mercy or leniency shown towards someone.
 
• **Tension (तनाव)**: refers to mental or emotional strain.
